_comment: Indicative map coordinates for the CO2 storage projects listed in storage-baseline.json, so they can be drawn as pins on the dashboard's world map. Keyed by the EXACT project 'name' string in storage-baseline.json — that file stays the authoritative record of what each project IS; this file only says where to draw it. Deliberately kept separate so the signed-off reconciliation dataset is never edited for a presentation concern.
precision: INDICATIVE, not surveyed. Coordinates locate the storage site (or, where noted, the capture plant) to roughly the nearest field or town. The dashboard map renders ~40 km per pixel at the equator, so errors of a few tens of km are sub-pixel and do not affect what the map communicates. Do NOT reuse these coordinates for anything requiring real positional accuracy — they are for visual placement only.

Snohvit.place: Snøhvit field, Barents Sea (capture at Melkøya, Hammerfest)

Northern Lights (Phase 1).place: Aurora storage site, North Sea (terminal at Øygarden)

Great Plains Synfuel -> Weyburn-Midale.place: Weyburn-Midale, Saskatchewan (CO2 piped from Beulah, North Dakota)

Coffeyville -> North Burbank Unit.place: North Burbank Unit, Oklahoma (capture at Coffeyville, Kansas)

Arkalon -> Farnsworth Unit.place: Farnsworth Unit, Texas panhandle (capture at Arkalon, Kansas)

ACTL (Nutrien + Sturgeon) -> Clive/Enhan.place: Clive field, Alberta (Alberta Carbon Trunk Line)
